The mistake almost every creator makes first is relying on third-party payment processors like Stripe and PayPal. These platforms offer a convenient way to accept payments, but they come with a price tag. They often block accounts from certain countries, including Ghana, Nigeria, and Kenya, due to perceived high-risk profiles. This not only costs you money but also undermines your business's credibility and reputation. By relying on these platforms, you're also exposing yourself to data breaches, account freezes, and other security risks. It's time to break free from the shackles of these payment processors and take control of your online store.
Why This Keeps Happening Even to Experienced Sellers

So, why does this keep happening even to experienced sellers? The answer lies in the way these payment processors operate. They use complex algorithms to assess risk, often relying on outdated and biased criteria. This can lead to false positives, where legitimate businesses are incorrectly flagged as high-risk. Experienced sellers may try to navigate these systems, but they often end up at the mercy of these platforms.
